description: A predefined connection point on a stencil, similar to draw.io constraints. When an edge connects to this point, it uses a fixed DiagramConnectionConstraint instead of floating port snapping.

members.name: Perimeter
members.description: When true, the point is projected onto the node perimeter based on its background shape. When false, the point is kept at the exact relative coordinate inside the bounding box.

members.name: RelativeX
members.description: Relative X position (0–1) within the stencil bounding box. 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge.

members.name: RelativeY
members.description: Relative Y position (0–1) within the stencil bounding box. 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge.
